def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    space_part = groups[1]
    time_part = groups[2]
    timestamp = int(date_part + time_part)
    space_count = len(space_part)
    return {'stored': [timestamp], 'layout': [space_count]}

def inverse(record):
    timestamp = str(record['stored'][0])
    space_count = record['layout'][0]
    date_part = timestamp[:6]
    time_part = timestamp[6:]
    return f"{date_part}{' ' * space_count}{time_part}"
